payload.leg_summary: CARD_TOKEN reports 2 settlement applications (Rs 10,000.00 total) for a single obligation (oblig_reconciliation_drift_001).
payload.canonical_expectation: One authorised obligation should reconcile to exactly one settlement of Rs 5,000.00.
payload.observed_mismatch: Rs 10,000.00 reconciled on CARD_TOKEN against an authorised obligation of Rs 5,000.00 - a duplicate/replayed settlement message added Rs 5,000.00 that was never authorised as a second transaction.
payload.explanation: The rail's local ledger applied 2 settlement events for one obligation (oblig_reconciliation_drift_001) instead of one. Each individual settlement message was locally well-formed - the failure only becomes visible when the obligation's own reconciliation total is checked against what the delegation actually authorised, which no single rail-local view does.
payload.containment_action: DUPLICATE_SETTLEMENT_REVERSED: obligation oblig_reconciliation_drift_001's excess settlement application(s) are reversed. Rs 5,000.00 of over-recognised exposure removed; the reconciled total is back to the single authorised obligation amount.

payload.rationale: The rail's local ledger applied 2 settlement events for one obligation (oblig_reconciliation_drift_001) instead of one. payload.leg_summary: CARD_TOKEN reports CAPTURED Rs 5,000.00; UPI_CIRCLE reports REFUNDED Rs 5,000.00 for the same obligation (oblig_settlement_conflict_001).
payload.canonical_expectation: A refund must trace back to the same rail/instrument that captured the funds; one obligation cannot be simultaneously settled and reversed across two uncoordinated rails.
payload.observed_mismatch: CARD_TOKEN=CAPTURE vs UPI_CIRCLE=REFUND for obligation oblig_settlement_conflict_001.
payload.explanation: Rail CARD_TOKEN and rail UPI_CIRCLE each independently processed a locally valid settlement instruction for obligation oblig_settlement_conflict_001. Neither rail can see the other's ledger, so neither one alone can detect the conflict - only a canonical view across both settlement legs can. Every authority-dimension invariant was satisfied at authorization time for both legs; this is a post-authorization lifecycle failure, not a delegated-authority violation.
payload.containment_action: SETTLEMENT_HOLD: obligation oblig_settlement_conflict_001 frozen pending manual reconciliation - the conflicting cross-rail leg is held and the original capture is not disturbed. Rs 5,000.00 of exposure released and frozen against obligation oblig_settlement_conflict_001.

payload.rationale: Rail CARD_TOKEN and rail UPI_CIRCLE each independently processed a locally valid settlement instruction for obligation oblig_settlement_conflict_001. Neither rail can see the other's ledger, so neither one alone can detect the conflict - only a canonical view across both settlement legs can. Every authority-dimension invariant was satisfied at authorization time for both legs; this is a post-authorization lifecycle failure, not a delegated-authority violation.
